Judah Lewis is an American actor and filmmaker born on May 22, 2001. He gained recognition for his roles in several films and television series. One of his notable performances was in the Netflix horror-comedy film "The Babysitter" (2017), where he starred as the lead character, Cole Johnson. His performance received positive reviews, and he reprised this role in the sequel, "The Babysitter: Killer Queen" (2020).

Lewis has also appeared in other projects, including the 2016 film "The Christmas Chronicles" alongside Kurt Russell, where he played a supporting role. In addition to his film work, he has made guest appearances on TV shows, including the series "Game of Silence."

In terms of his acting style, Lewis is known for his versatility, able to take on both comedic and dramatic roles. Beyond acting, he has expressed interest in directing and producing, showcasing his creativity and ambition in the entertainment industry.

As of my last update, he continues to be active in the industry, taking on new projects and expanding his career. Note that there may have been new developments or projects involving Judah Lewis since then.
